title: Senate committee rejects Trump nominee to lead National Science Foundation
description:
Committee chair Bill Cassidy, a Republican, said Jim O’Neill ‘did not do enough to stand up for science’ in previous posts

Jim O’Neill will not undergo a confirmation hearing on Wednesday to head he National Science Foundation (NSF) because he “did not do enough to stand up for science” in his previous position, said Bill Cassidy, a Republican from Louisiana who is chair of the Senate committee on health, education, labor and pensions.

This ends O’Neill’s run for the top US scientific organization, an embattled independent federal agency that has seen major budget cuts and grant freezes under the Trump administration. The next NSF nominee will face a Democratic-led Senate.
